sources.title: Free AI 3D Model Generator: Create 3D Assets at Zero Cost
sources.snippet: A free AI 3D model generator is a browser-based tool that uses neural networks to convert text prompts or 2D images into fully watertight 3D meshes. It works by computing volumetric occupancy through the Direct3D-S2 engine, extracting high-density blank triangular meshes in about 90 seconds.
